_targeting.review_fixes: Fable review 2026-08-17 found one integrity failure and it was fixed. The Huawei workshop bullet had ended 'with the operator's engineering stakeholders', a clause with no basis in the DB record, which turned out to have been copied from the worked style EXAMPLE in CV Writing Rules section 1 rather than from evidence. It also aggravated the DB note forbidding any claim of presenting or facilitating. Removed here and in the Google Customer Engineer context, which carried the identical clause. Also applied: cut the numberless rollback bullet, gave the 12-accounts bullet a Z, trimmed the summary, and added the JD's exact required-qualification wording to the skills line (Mobile Device Management, cybersecurity, channel, sales engineering) to lift keyword coverage past 80 percent.

profile_summary: Portfolio Solution Presales on a Tier-1 UK mobile network operator account at Huawei. Six years of technical customer-facing work, including four years at Apple from the store floor through B2B solution sales. Sold Apple into the enterprise: GBP 350,000 of B2B pipeline across a 50+ account portfolio, 12 accounts onboarded onto custom stores, and a GBP 50,000 broadcaster deal closed by clearing a device management objection with MDM. MSc Business Analytics, University of Exeter. London, full UK working rights, no sponsorship needed.

bullets: Own the evaluation and demo unit programme on a Tier-1 UK mobile network operator account, tracking 60 to 80 live evaluation units against launch deadlines and holding sign-off so product reaches the customer's evaluation teams ahead of their decision points.
Kept the proposal to what the network could actually carry by validating solution feasibility across 6 of the account's subnets, as the dedicated presales cover inside a 5-person pursuit team.
Produced the documented solution scope the pursuit was built on, working the full requirements cycle across 3 technical workshops and one structured analysis session.

Delivered 100 percent of the HKMA's regulatory mandates inside a hard 14-day window by turning the regulation into an implementation plan and coordinating internal teams with third-party vendors to ship Geo-IP fraud detection with impossible travel logic.
Handed back 8 hours a week of manual reporting across 20 systems, roughly 400 hours a year, by deploying a centralised Grafana observability framework in place of hand-assembled weekly reports.
Secured adoption from all 6 flagship store leaders by demoing the tool myself, walking each of them through their own use cases and daily upkeep before handing over ownership.
Delivered 3 hours of group training across cohorts of 3 to 5 Floor Champions, blending Shanghai system materials with locally customised content.

Closed a GBP 50,000 deal with Hong Kong broadcaster Viu TV over 3 months by turning a walk-in store visit into a qualified opportunity, earning trust with hands-on technical support and a custom business pricing portal, then clearing their device management objection by upselling MDM.
Onboarded 12 portfolio accounts onto custom stores, setting each one up with post-sales service coverage so the account stayed served after the sale.

Generated GBP 350,000 in new B2B pipeline across a 50+ account portfolio by running discovery, solution positioning and qualification end to end, then escalating matured accounts to the corporate team to close.

Resolved 21+ high-complexity technical inquiries a day in a flagship store by pairing structured root-cause diagnosis with plain-language translation of technical trade-offs for non-technical customers.
